matches.rationale: GT-1 concerns the methodological rigor of deriving the concise JMMD via the Representer theorem in Section 3.1, specifically the claim that tensor products disappear trivially. None of the findings address Section 3.1 or the Representer theorem derivation; all five findings target different equations and proofs in Sections 3.2–3.4 and the appendices.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine mathematical error in Theorem 1's proof (K² ⊙ M^J equality) not present in ground truth.
Correctly flags the identity matrix vs. all-ones matrix confusion in K¹ definition, not in ground truth.
Points out undefined M^H and uncentered HSIC formulation issues in Eq. (4), not in ground truth.
Identifies missing factor of 2 in Laplacian graph regularization equations (6) and (8), not in ground truth.
Flags invalid proof structure for K⁴ reproducing kernel property in Appendix E, not in ground truth.
